notes:
# v1.3.23 — Account tab skeleton loading

- New: the Account tab now shows shimmer skeleton placeholders over the three
  data regions while your stats load for the first time in a session — the hero
  (rank / level / progress), Chapter Milestones (badge grid, streak chips, goal
  values) and Reading Stats (the stat cards, the 14-day sparkline, and the Top
  Sources / Top Genres breakdowns).
- The skeleton appears only on the first load. Re-opening the tab, or any later
  refresh (saving a goal, clearing history, restoring a backup, changing the
  naming theme), updates the values silently with no skeleton flash.
- If a stats load fails, the skeleton is cleared and the previous placeholder
  text returns, so nothing is left shimmering.
- The Account, Appearance, Performance, Content, Data & Backup, Diagnostics and
  Updates panels stay interactive immediately and are not covered by the
  skeleton.
- No other behaviour changed.
